status_rule: Derive unlocked status at each Odysseus preflight only from current independently verified dependency receipts and matching data/source/code/config fingerprints. All stages are locked except MT-00 eligibility. Do not interpret these files as an implemented /goals runtime.
invalidation: change to algorithm or source configuration

goals.title: Audit sources and reproduce one local trend report
goals.unlock_when: Simulation-only and research-only operator intent; source terms/rate/cost eligibility explicitly checked.
acceptance: Run TrendScope offline demo or public-source-only smoke in isolated environment, without adopting its independent scheduler, persistence or credential integrations.
Confirm public source access and terms for GDELT DOC 2.0, HN API, crypto exchange public candles; Google Trends RSS/Bluesky are optional and may be blocked if terms uncertain.
No Reddit, X-cookie, YouTube internal scraping, Amazon captcha bypass, paid API or credential harvesting.
Evaluate integration complexity, license and service binding; report keep/drop with observed outputs and costs.
goals.failed_gate: Blocked until verified lawful source and safe runtime.

goals.title: Acquire timestamped evidence and market joins
acceptance: Collect daily public-source snapshots over seven days with source URL, publisher timestamp, first-seen timestamp, geography, entity/topic and collection error status.
Normalize and deduplicate stories without conflating syndicated duplicates with independent evidence.
If prices joined, use identical public exchange candles and instrument identity from FT data contract where available; no new exchange/trading keys.
Store source licensing metadata and avoid republishing copyrighted full text.
Data completeness, latency, timezone, source changes, id mapping and basic tests verified.
goals.failed_gate: No downstream claims from unverifiable or retrospective-only sources.

goals.title: Produce interpretable attention and opportunity signals
goals.unlock_when: MT-01 complete and snapshot freshness checks pass.
acceptance: Compute explainable first-seen topic count, source diversity, rolling attention velocity and novelty against simple historical baseline; do not equate sentiment with predicted price direction.
Separate market-moving-event hypotheses, general attention trends and potential unmet-demand opportunities.
Produce one weekly top-five evidence-linked digest, with counterevidence, uncertainty and source coverage; no automated publishing or outreach.
No unbounded LLM/topic optimisation; proposed insights are candidates, not ratified findings.
goals.failed_gate: If signals are mostly duplicates, noise or retrospective, revise or stop.

goals.title: Blind forward-check signal quality and operator value
goals.unlock_when: MT-02 has timestamped reproducible daily outputs and a frozen evaluation rubric.
acceptance: At least 14 calendar days of unattended shadow monitoring with time-of-observation evidence; use more time if fewer than 30 distinct dated topic/events.
Compare relevance, novelty, false-alert rate, source coverage, missingness and summarisation accuracy with simple keyword and popularity baselines.
Record delivered versus rejected signals, human review effort, running cost, and whether trends were actionable rather than merely popular.
Independent reviewer reports pass, fail or insufficient; do not infer price predictive edge from this gate.
goals.failed_gate: Insufficient evidence stays locked; no automatic higher-complexity build.

goals.title: Test additional predictive value in paper trading
goals.unlock_when: MT-03 pass and current FT-02 backtesting validity receipt available; cross-program dependency enforced by existing Odysseus evaluator when implemented.
acceptance: Define event timestamp at first observable collection time, not article publication alone; apply realistic collection, inference and order-decision delay.
Freeze one media-feature hypothesis and compare the same Freqtrade spot strategy with and without the media feature using chronological holdouts and matched costs.
Report false positives, multiple testing, returns, drawdown and baseline-relative metrics; keep trading simulation only.
Paper signal export disabled by default and fail-closed on stale/unsupported observations.
goals.failed_gate: No media-feature promotion if it does not beat price-only benchmark; paper trading never authorises live trading.

goals.title: Assess repeatable intelligence product opportunity
goals.unlock_when: MT-03 demonstrates useful and reliable evidence with current rights audit.
acceptance: Identify one bounded buyer problem solvable from collected signals and compare with freely available reporting.
Estimate incremental running cost, operator oversight, repeatability, copyright/API commercial rights and plausible distribution channel.
Produce a human-reviewed one-page opportunity/no-go assessment, not a business launch.
Any external commercial outreach, subscription, payments, redistribution or live financial action needs explicit new approval.
goals.failed_gate: No monetisation assumption based only on trend popularity.
